## Description

AI service endpoint for one turn: input is the recent messages, the tenant's AI settings, retrieved clinic knowledge and the allowed tools; output is a reply or a tool request. Medvya validates and runs the tool (find slots, book, reschedule, cancel, find doctor or branch) through the existing services with the verified patient, then continues the turn. Red-flag symptoms are caught in code before any model call. No medical advice. Message text is untrusted input. Each turn records model, prompt hash, tools requested and tools run. Choose the knowledge index store (pgvector under row-level security or Azure AI Search per country).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** The model never receives a tool it is not allowed; a tool request outside the list is refused by Medvya (test).
- [ ] **AC2.** Red-flag messages end in the emergency message and a staff alert with no model call (test).
- [ ] **AC3.** Evaluation cases in CI: booking, reschedule, cancel, refusal of medical advice, prompt injection in a message, another tenant's knowledge never retrieved.
- [ ] **AC4.** Each turn is audited without message text.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
